meta.description: Sync tests with TestRail. Use when user mentions "testrail", "test management", "test cases", "test run", "sync test cases", "push results to testrail", or "import from testrail".

copy.tagline_en: Sync test cases and results with TestRail

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以双向同步 Playwright 测试与 TestRail 测试管理工具：从 TestRail 导入测试用例生成 Playwright 测试，将测试结果推回 TestRail，创建测试运行，查看同步状态，以及更新 TestRail 中的测试用例。
howto.when: 当你提到“testrail”、“测试管理”、“测试用例”、“测试运行”、“同步测试用例”、“推送结果到 testrail”或“从 testrail 导入”时触发。

say.text: 从 TestRail 项目 1 的套件 2 导入测试用例
将 Playwright 测试结果推送到 TestRail 运行 42

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can bidirectionally sync Playwright tests with TestRail: import test cases from TestRail to generate Playwright tests, push test results back to TestRail, create test runs, view sync status, and update test cases in TestRail.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "testrail", "test management", "test cases", "test run", "sync test cases", "push results to testrail", or "import from testrail".

say_en.text: Import test cases from TestRail project 1 suite 2
say_en.note: Claude will fetch cases via MCP and generate Playwright test files.

say_en.text: Push Playwright test results to TestRail run 42
say_en.note: Claude will run tests and push results to the specified run.

say_en.text: Create a TestRail test run named "Sprint 42 Regression"
say_en.note: Claude will create the run via MCP and return the run ID.
